India’s birth rate is falling fast—and it’s not hard to see why. Young Indians are choosing not to have children because life today is expensive, stressful, and uncertain. From unaffordable housing and school fees to toxic workplaces and zero work–life balance, raising a child feels like a financial and emotional burden.

Add to that the pressure of childcare, lack of support systems, rising medical costs, and the desire for personal freedom—parenthood is no longer the default choice.

In this video, we break down why India is quietly entering a no-baby era, and what it means for the future.
